results.title: Neda
results.overview: An Iranian interpreter at the Federal Office for Migration and Refugees encounters her former torturer, now seeking asylum himself. Caught between her professional duty and the pursuit of justice, she needs to decide how far she is willing to go.

results.title: Louma - Familie ist kein Kinderspiel
results.overview: When Louma dies far too young, she leaves behind four children by two different fathers. The two men are like oil and water. coffee house entrepreneur Tristan and musician Mo only have in common that they were both in relationship with the same woman. What should happen to the children now? Neither would trust the other with their children. When the child welfare services want to separate the children, their daughter Fritte has an idea: To prevent the siblings from being torn apart, the mismatched fathers move in together under one roof. Simple enough, right?

results.title: Game of Identity
results.overview: The story tells the story of Liu Quan Long, a lowly born and independent struggling young man who got the opportunity to exchange his life with a boy from another class in a famous university. Unexpectedly, what was waiting for him was a thrilling game.  Liu Quan Long is an impoverished young man who can't afford to go to university but has a great talent. Before meeting Chen Lun, he was an Internet cafe administrator outside the university who would never be noticed.  Chen Lun has a distinguished family and studied at an elite university just across the street from an internet cafe, but he had no intention of going to school. In order to cope with his parents abroad, he offered Liu Quan Long an invitation to the game of "identity exchange" and asked Liu Quan Long to replace him.

results.title: Lea Desandre Sings Vivaldi @ Salzburger Festspiele 2026
results.original_title: Lea Desandre chante Vivaldi Festival de Salzbourg 2026
results.overview: The programme features arias from Vivaldi’s operas and oratorios, as well as two of his cello concertos, performed by cellists Nicolas Altstaedt and Bruno Philippe. The young Franco-Italian mezzo-soprano Lea Desandre performs on the world’s leading concert and opera stages and won the Opus Klassik award for Singer of the Year in 2022.

results.title: Conjurig
results.overview: Following a sudden job loss and the dissolution of his romantic relationship in the capital, a dejected young man retreats to his hometown of Bandung, masking his psychological vulnerabilities by donning a traditional ghost costume within a local street-performing subculture.

results.title: Deep Hallows - A Brazilian Gothic Fable
results.original_title: Furnas Fundas: Uma Fábula Gótica Brasileira
results.overview: The small town of Furnas Fundas hides a secret far older than its pastures, forests, or the people who live there. During a heated election marred by scandals, Bartira, known merely as the town drunk, unexpectedly finds herself at the center of it all. It’s up to her to face a dark force that has returned to turn the town into a true bloodbath.

results.title: Fire Tornado
results.overview: A dysfunctional rehab group is stranded at a rundown cabin as a roaring firenado melts everything in its path. With roads gone and heat rising, the misfits must combine their strange skills to fortify the house and survive the firestorm’s return.

results.title: Eva
results.overview: On a romantic journey through isolated landscapes, a couple discovers that the most unsettling danger may arise from what they choose to hide or reveal.

results.title: Sebatas Waktu
results.overview: Thahirah tries to buy a mobile phone for her younger brother Thoha, initiating an episode full of sorrow.

results.title: Lady Liberty: Secrets of an Icon
results.original_title: Liberté, la statue qui voulait changer le monde
results.overview: This iconic statue was a gift from France to the new-born American Republic and was the first crowd-funded monument of all time. A symbol of emancipation and freedom, which took two decades to be completed. The film features original 3D virtual reconstitutions of Auguste Bartholdi’s Atelier in Paris and travels back in time to bring viewers at the heart of the Statue’s original construction, revealing the founding ideals of our democracies.

results.title: The Violin Case
results.overview: A painter has the worst night of his life after leaving his violin artwork in the back of a taxi in Macao.

results.title: Taratata - Hommage spécial à Catherine Ringer
results.original_title: Taratata - Hommage spécial à Catherine Ringer

results.title: The Observance
results.overview: After five years in a coma following a fatal car accident, Madison Neubauer wakes to find her home and family in the grip of 'The Observance', a religious cult who will stop at nothing to protect their secrets.

results.title: To Kill a Nazi
results.overview: A documentary feature by award-winning filmmaker Boaz Dvir, “To Kill a Nazi” tells the story of a French family man who sets out in to kill his father’s Gestapo executioner and ended up playing a pivotal role in history’s most audacious hostage rescue.

results.title: Steal This Story, Please!
results.overview: New York-based independent investigative journalist Amy Goodman has been reporting from hotspots around the world for decades: from East Timor to Morocco, Nigeria, and Gaza, and closer to home during 9/11 and the Iraq War. Goodman and a small group of colleagues present the daily online, TV, and radio news program Democracy Now!, which has been on the air since 1996 with no government funding, thanks to contributions from donors, foundations, and news consumers.

results.overview: The seventh night of Road to Wrestling Dontaku 2026 took place on April 30, 2026, at Grand Messe Kumamoto in Mashiki, Kumamoto, Japan.

results.title: Because I Love You
results.overview: After 10 years stranded alone on a spaceship, Nova's life takes an unexpected turn when an alien comes on board. They form a deep bond as they explore the universe together.
